quality.reason: Es un nombre de persona real y una firma de gestión de activos.

evidence.quote: Craig Thompson Partner, Chief Operations Officer and Head of Risk Craig joined Trinity Street in 2009 and has nearly 30 years of experience in the financial industry. He is responsible for overseeing internal risk controls, performance measurement and settlements, and leads the back-office team, utilizing a range of industry-standard and customized software solutions to ensure accurate and in-depth risk and performance analysis. Prior to Trinity Street, he spent 13 years at JP Morgan (Asset Management in London and Custody in Sydney) and 4 years working in public accounting in Australia.
